description.en: Colorize original Game Boy games. 'Auto' picks the most appropriate palette. 'GBC' and 'SGB' use the game's official palette on those systems. 'Internal' uses the palette selected below. 'Custom' loads a palette file added in the core's BIOS files.
description.zh-Hans: 给黑白 GB 游戏上色。「自动」挑选最合适的配色；「GBC」「SGB」使用游戏在 GBC 或超级 GB 上的官方配色；「内部」使用下面选择的配色；「自定义」读取在核心 BIOS 中添加的调色板文件。

description.en: Palette used when 'GB Colorization' is set to 'Internal'. 'GB' palettes mimic original Game Boy hardware, 'GBC'/'SGB' are official console palettes, and TWB64/PixelShift are community packs.
description.zh-Hans: 「GB 上色」设为「内部」时使用的配色。GB 开头的配色模拟初代 GB 的屏幕，GBC 和 SGB 开头的是官方机型配色，TWB64 与 PixelShift 是社区制作的配色包。

description.en: The palette used when 'Internal Palette' is set to 'TWB64 - Pack 1'.
description.zh-Hans: 「内部调色板」选择 TWB64 - Pack 1 时使用的具体配色。

description.en: The palette used when 'Internal Palette' is set to 'TWB64 - Pack 2'.
description.zh-Hans: 「内部调色板」选择 TWB64 - Pack 2 时使用的具体配色。

description.en: The palette used when 'Internal Palette' is set to 'TWB64 - Pack 3'.
description.zh-Hans: 「内部调色板」选择 TWB64 - Pack 3 时使用的具体配色。

description.en: The palette used when 'Internal Palette' is set to 'PixelShift - Pack 1'.
description.zh-Hans: 「内部调色板」选择 PixelShift - Pack 1 时使用的具体配色。

description.en: Adjusts output colors to match the display of real Game Boy Color hardware. 'GBC Only' ensures that correction will only be applied when playing Game Boy Color games, or when using a Game Boy Color palette to colorize a Game Boy game. 'Always' applies color correction to all content, and will produce unexpected/suboptimal results when using 'GB' or 'SGB' internal color palettes.
description.zh-Hans: 调整输出颜色，使其接近真实 GBC 屏幕的观感。「仅 GBC」只在 GBC 游戏或使用 GBC 配色时生效。

description.en: Specifies method used when performing color correction. 'Accurate' produces output almost indistinguishable from a real Game Boy Color LCD panel. 'Fast' merely darkens colors and reduces saturation, and may be used on low-end hardware if the 'Accurate' method is too slow.
description.zh-Hans: 「精确」几乎和真实 GBC 屏幕一致；「快速」只是压暗并降低饱和度，性能开销更小。

description.en: Simulates the physical response of the Game Boy Color LCD panel when illuminated from different angles. 'Central' represents standard color reproduction. 'Above Screen' increases brightness. 'Below Screen' reduces brightness. This setting only applies when 'Color Correction Mode' is set to 'Accurate'.
description.zh-Hans: 模拟 GBC 屏幕在不同角度补光下的观感。「居中」为标准效果，「屏幕上方」更亮，「屏幕下方」更暗。仅在校正方式为「精确」时生效。

title.zh-Hans: 色彩校正 - 前光位置

description.en: Enable luminosity-based brightness reduction. May be used to avoid glare/eye strain when playing games with white backgrounds, which are intended for display on a non-backlit Game Boy Color and can therefore appear uncomfortably bright when viewed on a modern backlit screen.
description.zh-Hans: 按亮度降低画面整体亮度。GB 游戏常用白色背景，在现代屏幕上会显得刺眼，可用这个选项缓解。

description.en: Simulates LCD ghosting effects. 'Simple' performs a 50:50 mix of the current and previous frames. 'LCD Ghosting' mimics natural LCD response times by combining multiple buffered frames. 'Simple' blending is required when playing games that rely on LCD ghosting for transparency effects (Wave Race, Ballistic, Chikyuu Kaihou Gun ZAS...).
description.zh-Hans: 模拟 LCD 残影。「简单」把当前帧和上一帧各取一半混合；「LCD 残影」用多帧模拟真实屏幕的响应速度。部分游戏靠残影实现半透明效果，这时需要开启。

description.en: Specify which algorithm to use when resampling generated audio (the Game Boy audio rate is limited only by its CPU write speed, such that 'native' frequencies are impractical on modern sound devices and must be downsampled). 'Sinc' produces the highest quality. 'Cosine' improves performance on low-end hardware.
description.zh-Hans: 把 GB 的原始音频重采样到现代设备可用的频率时使用的算法。Sinc 音质最好，Cosine 性能开销更低。

description.en: Specify which type of hardware to emulate. 'Auto' is recommended. Selecting 'GBA' unlocks extra features in certain 'GBA Enhanced' Game Boy Color games (Shantae, Wendy - Every Witch Way, Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Seasons/Ages...).
description.zh-Hans: 模拟哪种机型，推荐「自动」。选择 GBA 会解锁部分「GBA 增强」GBC 游戏的额外内容，例如《Shantae》《塞尔达传说：织梦岛》系列的时空之章/大地之章。

description.en: Enable support for official Game Boy and Game Boy Color bootloaders, with corresponding start-up logo animations.
description.zh-Hans: 使用 GB 和 GBC 的官方启动程序，开机时会显示任天堂的开机动画。需要在核心 BIOS 中添加对应文件。

description.en: Enabling this will allow pressing/quickly alternating/holding both left and right (or up and down) directions at the same time. This may cause movement-based glitches.
description.zh-Hans: 允许同时按下「上+下」或「左+右」，可能导致部分游戏出现移动异常。

title.zh-Hans: 允许相反方向同时按下

description.en: Enables haptic feedback effects for supported games (Pokemon Pinball, Perfect Dark...).
description.zh-Hans: 为支持震动的游戏（《宝可梦弹珠台》《完美黑暗》等）设置震动强度。
